routes.title: Secure coding at trust boundaries
routes.summary: changing application code that handles untrusted input or authorization

applicability.text: Apply when application code consumes untrusted input or changes an authorization boundary.

normativeRequirements.text: validate untrusted values before using them at a trust boundary.
include a negative authorization test for security-sensitive behavior.
place credentials in source, fixtures, logs, or error messages.

exceptionsAndEscalation.text: A temporary exception requires an owner, rationale, compensating control, approver, and expiry date.
Stop and escalate to the fictional security owner when authority or policy meaning is uncertain.

routes.title: Vulnerability triage
routes.summary: assessing and routing a reported security finding

applicability.text: Apply when a suspected product or dependency vulnerability is reported.

normativeRequirements.text: record severity evidence and an accountable owner before changing finding status.

exceptionsAndEscalation.text: Leave the finding open and escalate to the fictional product security lead when severity or ownership is uncertain.
